page_title: LEV 6-0 HEI | Bayer Leverkusen v Heidenheim 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Bastian Dankert is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+1' Alejo Sarco (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to the corner kick on the edge of the box and releases a quick strike. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
90+1' Corner kick. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

88' The ball rebounds to Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
85' Heidenheim hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
83' Substitution. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) replaces Marnon Busch.

82' That was close by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
82' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short corner kick.

82' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Diant Ramaj was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
81' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.
78' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
75' Kasper Hjulmand prepares a substitution. Aleix Garcia is replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen).

74' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Diant Ramaj has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
74' The Heidenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
70' Bayer Leverkusen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
67' Mathias Honsak comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
65' The Heidenheim players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
64' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
61' Total attempts – 18:0.
58' Bayer Leverkusen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
57' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the corner.
56' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to make a change. Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Edmond Tapsoba.
56' Substitution. Patrik Schick leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alejo Sarco (Bayer Leverkusen).
56' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.

53' 6 - 0 Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Diant Ramaj is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 6:0.
51' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
48' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Arthur will be replaced by Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' Substitution. Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ernest Poku walks off.
46' Here is a change. Jan Schoppner is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Adam Kolle (Heidenheim).
46' The whistle blows and Bastian Dankert starts the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45+1' 5 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Aleix Garcia plays it into the box, and Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 5:0.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.
42' Nice passing game by Heidenheim. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
39' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
36' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.

34' What a big chance! Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
33' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
33' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) replacing Julian Niehues.
33' The manager makes a subsitution with Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) coming on for Budu Zivzivadze.

31' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Diant Ramaj pulls off an easy save.
30' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

27' 4 - 0 It's a goal! Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) scores with a brilliant shot into the top left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Arthur. The score is now 4:0.
26' Ball possession – 71:29.
24' Bayer Leverkusen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
22' 3 - 0 Goal! Diant Ramaj makes a huge mistake and Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 3:0.
19' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

16' 2 - 0 Goal! Edmond Tapsoba hands Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
14' Bayer Leverkusen keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

12' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Diant Ramaj pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
10' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
10' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayer Leverkusen.
5' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' The Bayer Leverkusen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

2' 1 - 0 Goal! Ernest Poku displays great vision and sends a pass to Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will supervise the game today.
